rationale: C22 is the strongest candidate because it delegates presidential authority partly to the Director of the Bureau of the Budget, matching the child’s named delegate. C11 and C05 also use compact presidential-delegation formulations. However, the child’s operative text is not supplied, and the available overlap consists only of a generic delegation function and, for C22, the same office. That is insufficient to establish distinctive shared language, a parallel operative sequence, or materially reused administrative machinery.
